title: queue_snapshot
description: The loop's view of the claim queue at the end of one claim pass: the candidates in rank order with each one's score, its factors and whether the claim rule would take it (and if not, why not), the claims left under the in-flight cap and the owner's controls in force. Written when the view changes and as a heartbeat when it does not, so the newest snapshot of a repo shows how fresh the loop's view is. A claim pass's immediate write is reason changed. Written by the factory loop.

taken_at.description: When the pass that produced the view ended.

reason.description: Why the snapshot was written: changed (the view differs from the last write; a claim pass's immediate write is always this) or heartbeat (unchanged, written to show the loop is alive).

considered.description: How many candidates the claim rule considered this pass: the whole list, before the cap on candidates below.

candidates.description: The first 50 candidates in rank order. why is null exactly when claimable is true.

rank.description: The place in the order, from 1.

score.description: The claim rule's score for the issue; null when it was not scored.

factors.description: Each factor that added to the score, with its points, in the rule's order; null when not scored.

points.description: The points the factor added to the score.

claimable.description: Whether the claim rule would take the issue this pass.

why.description: Why the claim rule would not take the issue this pass, as a code; null when it would. blocked: blocked by open issues. skipped: a skip label or 'owner: skip'. paused: 'owner: paused'. outside_only: outside the owner's 'only' list. no_slot: no capacity left (the in-flight cap, 'owner: one at a time' or the claims-per-pass limit). new_off: 'owner: no new work'. usage_tier: the usage tier stops new work (stop-new, stop-all) or the slow-tier limits apply. rejected: carries the rejected label. tracker: a tracker (it has sub-issues, or an epic title). held: a live record, a claim in flight, or another device holds it. exhausted: the claim attempts are used up. untrusted: the author is not trusted. unknown: a fact was not read, or the issue read as closed or without the ready label.

rest.description: The candidates past the first 50, counted by why code (null = claimable). Empty when there are 50 or fewer.

why.description: Why the claim rule would not take the issue this pass, as a code; null when it would. blocked: blocked by open issues. skipped: a skip label or 'owner: skip'. paused: 'owner: paused'. outside_only: outside the owner's 'only' list. no_slot: no capacity left (the in-flight cap, 'owner: one at a time' or the claims-per-pass limit). new_off: 'owner: no new work'. usage_tier: the usage tier stops new work (stop-new, stop-all) or the slow-tier limits apply. rejected: carries the rejected label. tracker: a tracker (it has sub-issues, or an epic title). held: a live record, a claim in flight, or another device holds it. exhausted: the claim attempts are used up. untrusted: the author is not trusted. unknown: a fact was not read, or the issue read as closed or without the ready label.

count.description: How many candidates past the first 50 have this why code.

free_slots.description: Claims left under maxInFlightIssues this pass; null when the cap is unset.

owner_priority.description: The owner's priority list in force; empty when off.

owner_only.description: The owner's 'only' list in force; empty when off.

owner_serial.description: Whether the owner's 'one at a time' control is on.

owner_new_off.description: Whether the owner's 'no new work' control is on.

folded.description: How many queue changes since the previous write this write folds in; 0 for a heartbeat with no change.
